args.goal: Turn the existing catalogue QA capability into one bilingual, private commission terms proposal for an authorized operator. Read the verified live offer, completed text-only rehearsal, Interac contract and any committed evidence from CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS. Reuse any equivalent draft. The existing readiness mission owns triage replies and order eligibility. This mission owns the actual proposed terms and the acceptance test. Specify one bounded deliverable, supported input, exclusions, AI disclosure, acceptance procedure and a proposed CAD price grounded in the existing hypothesis, clearly marked unvalidated and pending operator approval. Use the observed clean control and same-style duplicate-image result to verify the promised findings and their location granularity. Include explicit handling for an out-of-scope input and a finding that needs manual interpretation. Save and read back the proposed terms, their SHA-256 and the acceptance crosswalk under products/services/catalogue-commission-terms/. Keep the proposal internal. A real eligible request, operator-approved terms and administrative acceptance are required before any paid order. Do not send externally, create an order, issue payment instructions, access private mail, spend or deploy. Complete under valid ownership with evidence and a lesson. Any eventual public release requires host-enforced independent review.
